        internal static ConfigTable Table

                Resolve();
                return _table;
            }

            int idx;
            IntPtr p = t.ByID(id, out idx);
            if (p == IntPtr.Zero)

                return new Item(p, t.Version, idx);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>按 Excel 序行下标取行；越界返回 null。</summary>
        public static Item? ByIndex(int i)
        {
            ConfigTable t = Table;
            IntPtr p = t.RowAt(i);

        /// <summary>Exact-string CodeName lookup; returns null when missing.</summary>
        public static Item? ByCodeName(string codeName)
        {
            ConfigTable t = Table;
            int row = Runtime.ByCodeName(TableName, 1, codeName);
            if (row < 0)
            {
                return null;
            }
            else
            {
                IntPtr p = t.RowAt(row);
                return new Item(p, t.Version, row);
            }
        }
